name: Necopidem
summary: Necopidem is a drug in the imidazopyridine family, which is related to the better known drugs zolpidem and alpidem. It is therefore considered a nonbenzodiazepine and as such may have sedative and anxiolytic effects, given its structural similarity to other nonbenzodiazepine hypnotics.

pharmacology.text: It is therefore considered a nonbenzodiazepine and as such may have sedative and anxiolytic effects, given its structural similarity to other nonbenzodiazepine hypnotics.

summaryZh: 奈可吡旦（英語：Necopidem）是咪唑並吡啶家族中的一種藥物，與更廣為人知的藥物唑吡坦和阿吡坦有關。因此，它被認為是一種非苯二氮䓬類藥物，鑑於其與其他非苯二氮䓬類催眠藥的結構相似，因此可能具有鎮靜和抗焦慮作用。

uses.en: It was investigated as a sedative and anti-anxiety drug but was never marketed.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究作為鎮靜與抗焦慮藥物，但從未上市。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究作为镇静与抗焦虑药物，但从未上市。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its kind, which act at the benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor, cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory gaps and, with regular use, dependence and a dangerous withdrawal that can include seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同類作用於 GABA-A 受體苯二氮平位點的藥物，會造成嗜睡、協調變差、記憶斷片，長期使用還會造成依賴，戒斷時可能出現包含癲癇發作的危險反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同类作用于 GABA-A 受体苯二氮平位点的药物，会造成嗜睡、协调制差、记忆断片，长期使用还会造成依赖，戒断时可能出现包含癫痫发作的危险反应。

fact.en: It is a close relative of zolpidem and alpidem, two imidazopyridines developed by the French company Synthelabo. Alpidem was withdrawn after reports of liver damage.
fact.zh: 它與佐沛眠和阿吡坦（alpidem）關係密切，這兩種咪唑吡啶類藥物由法國 Synthelabo 公司研發，其中阿吡坦因肝損傷報告而撤市。
fact.zhHans: 它与佐沛眠和阿吡坦（alpidem）关系密切，这两种咪唑吡啶类药物由法国 Synthelabo 公司研发，其中阿吡坦因肝损伤报告而撤市。
